name: Passkey Registration to Home
summary: The user confirms enrollment, the server creates exactly one durable user, binds the proved passkey credential, establishes the home workspace, and opens the application home view.

preconditions.expression: pending-identity-status == resolution-required and credential-proof == passkey-proved and durable-identity == absent

serverInteraction.intent: Create one durable user, bind the proved pending passkey credential, establish the required home workspace, and issue the authenticated session.

postconditions.expression: pending-identity-status == resolved and durable-identity == resolved and credential-proof == passkey-proved and home-workspace == established
